title: OpenAI confidentially files IPO S-1 with SEC
summary: OpenAI filed a confidential S-1 registration statement with the SEC on May 22, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading. Targeting September 2026 debut at up to $1 trillion valuation.

title: Anthropic closes $30B funding round at $900B+ valuation
summary: Anthropic raised more than $30 billion at a pre-money valuation above $900 billion, surpassing OpenAI's $852 billion valuation. One of the largest private funding rounds in AI history.

title: Google unveils Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini Spark agent, and Gemini Omni at I/O 2026
summary: Google announced Gemini 3.5 Flash as the new default Gemini model, Gemini Spark (24/7 personal AI agent), and Gemini Omni for video generation at Google I/O 2026.

title: NVIDIA delivers Vera CPU to Anthropic, OpenAI, Oracle, and SpaceXAI
summary: NVIDIA's first CPU built for agentic AI delivery to top AI labs, delivering 2x efficiency and 50% faster performance than traditional rack-scale CPUs.

title: Anthropic launches Claude for Small Business with connectors for QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot
summary: Claude for Small Business launches with connectors to QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, DocuSign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365. Includes 15 agentic workflows.

title: NVIDIA Hermes unlocks self-improving AI agents powered by Qwen 3.6 on RTX PCs
summary: NVIDIA Hermes launches as a self-improving AI agent running on local RTX PCs and DGX Spark, powered by Qwen 3.6 models from Alibaba.

title: Anthropic acquires Stainless to expand agent connectivity
summary: Anthropic acquires Stainless, a leader in SDKs and MCP server tooling, to extend Claude's ability to connect to data and tools.

title: Anthropic forms $200M partnership with Gates Foundation
summary: Anthropic partners with Gates Foundation to commit $200M in grant funding and Claude credits for global health, education, and economic mobility programs.

title: NVIDIA reports record Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6B
summary: NVIDIA shatters expectations with $81.6B revenue in Q1 FY2027, up 85% year-over-year, driven by massive demand for Blackwell GPUs and data center expansion.

title: KPMG integrates Claude across core business and workforce of 276,000 in strategic alliance
summary: KPMG and Anthropic announce global alliance with Claude integrated into KPMG's Digital Gateway platform and available to all 276,000+ employees.

title: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang at Dell Technologies World: demand going parabolic
summary: Jensen Huang joins Michael Dell to unveil Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA, delivering agentic AI inference at one-tenth the cost per token with Vera Rubin NVL72.

title: PwC deploying Claude to build technology, execute deals, and reinvent enterprise functions
summary: PwC expands partnership with Anthropic to deploy Claude across technology development, deal execution, and enterprise function transformation for clients.

title: Anthropic announces higher usage limits for Claude and compute deal with SpaceX
summary: Anthropic raises Claude usage limits and announces compute partnership with SpaceX to support next-generation AI development and deployment.

title: NVIDIA and Google Cloud empower next wave of AI builders
summary: At Google I/O, NVIDIA and Google Cloud announce expanded collaboration to accelerate work of over 100,000 developers in their joint developer community.

title: Anthropic publishes approach to widening conversation on frontier AI
summary: Anthropic shares its framework for responsible frontier AI development, including safety measures, deployment considerations, and industry collaboration.

title: NVIDIA and Ineffable Intelligence team up for reinforcement learning infrastructure
summary: NVIDIA partners with Ineffable Intelligence to build the future of reinforcement learning infrastructure, advancing AI systems that learn by trial and error.

title: Project Glasswing uncovers over 10,000 software vulnerabilities using AI
summary: Project Glasswing, the industry coalition including AWS, Anthropic, Apple, Google, Microsoft, and NVIDIA, shares progress on securing world's critical software.

title: I/O 2026: Welcome to the agentic Gemini era
summary: Google I/O 2026 marks the shift to agentic AI with Gemini, featuring new capabilities including Gemini 3.5 Flash, Daily Brief, and Gemini Spark.

title: NVIDIA GTC Taipei at COMPUTEX: Live updates on what's next in AI
summary: NVIDIA GTC Taipei at COMPUTEX brings together developers, researchers, and industry leaders to explore AI breakthroughs spanning AI factories, agentic AI, and scaling infrastructure.

title: Anthropic launches agents for financial services
summary: Anthropic releases specialized Claude agents for financial services, helping banks, investment firms, and insurance companies automate complex workflows.

title: NVIDIA and SAP bring trust to specialized agents with OpenShell integration
summary: NVIDIA and SAP expand collaboration to help enterprises run specialized agents with security and governance controls through OpenShell open-source runtime.

title: Anthropic Claude Platform on AWS now generally available
summary: Claude Platform on AWS launches in GA, giving AWS customers direct access to Anthropic's native Claude Platform experience including Managed Agents, web search, code execution, and Skills.

title: Google Beam brings better group meetings with 6-person video calling
summary: Google Beam (formerly Project Starline) launches with 6-person video calling capability, featuring life-like presence and spatial audio for more natural remote meetings.

title: xAI completes training Grok V9-Medium, a 1.5T-parameter model
summary: Elon Musk says xAI finished training Grok V9-Medium, a 1.5T-parameter model trained with substantial Cursor data, with fine-tuning underway and public release expected in 2-3 weeks.
